name: SPIRE FALL: The Inheritance Game
description: A lavishly produced corponation-warfare strategy game in which 2–6 players control dynastic Spire families maneuvering to inherit a collapsed megacorporation's assets across a modular board representing Meridian 88's district grid. Players spend Quanta tokens, place influence tiles, and deploy geneware-modified heir pieces, each with unique stat profiles printed on embedded smart-chip cards. The production quality is deliberately obscene — gold-foil tiles, weighted resin pieces — targeted squarely at Tier 4-5 buyers.
story_hooks: A runner is hired to steal a specific limited-edition heir piece rumored to contain encrypted financial data in its resin core.
A Tier 2 analyst who reverse-engineered the game's strategy becomes a cult figure, hired by Tier 5 families as a 'board coach.'
The game's modular board is discovered to be an eerily accurate map of a real contested district — accurate to infrastructure not on any public record.
